description: Count business days between start and end (inclusive), or find the date that is N business days after start (add=N; negative N goes backward; start itself is not counted). Uses the country's weekend days, public holidays and make-up working days. For Japan, set year_end_closed to also skip 12/29-1/3.

add.description: Move this many business days from start.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. US, GB, DE, CN, JP). Defaults to JP (Japan) when omitted.

include_government.description: Outside Japan: also treat days off only for government offices (e.g. Indonesia's cuti bersama, Canadian federal holidays) as days off.

region.description: Outside Japan: state/province code (ISO 3166-2 suffix, e.g. CA for California) to include regional holidays.

name: business_days
title: Business days
